title: calyptocarpus biaristatus
intro: Calyptocarpus biaristatus, commonly known as Powderpuff, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in West African countries, for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Calyptocarpus biaristatus include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can help in soothing skin irritations and wounds, as well as providing relief from fever and pain. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties.
